meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后,涉及 Git 提交或历史查询时,Claude 会先分类(提交/改写/查询),只提交你指定的改动并拆分无关部分;查历史用 git log、blame 等并附证据;改写前检查分支与脏文件,不擅自提交、推送或改写。
howto.when: 当任务需要 Git 提交或历史调查时触发,包括提交、查询历史、改写历史等;普通代码编辑不触发,除非你明确要求做 Git 操作。

say.text: 帮我把工作区的改动按功能拆成两个提交。
say.note: 会先看 diff,再按原子分组提交。

say.text: 查一下 src/app.js 第 15 行是谁写的,什么时候加的。
say.note: 用 git blame 查询并附提交证据。

say.text: 把最近三个提交合并成一个,消息写 '修复登录 bug'。
say.note: 会用 rebase 改写,先确认分支状态。

howto.what_en: For git tasks, Claude classifies (commit/rewrite/query), commits only requested changes, splits unrelated ones; uses git log/blame etc.; checks branch/dirty files before rewriting; never commits/pushes/rewrites unasked.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs Git commit/history work, including commits, history queries, rewriting, etc.; ordinary code edits don't trigger unless explicitly asked for Git work.

say_en.text: Split my working tree changes into two commits by feature.
say_en.note: It will inspect the diff and group atomically.

say_en.text: Check who wrote line 15 of src/app.js and when it was added.
say_en.note: Uses git blame and cites evidence.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one with message 'Fix login bug'.
say_en.note: Uses rebase after verifying branch safety.
